name: Sao Beach
summary: Southeast beach: swim the calm shallows for a half day, and come early on a weekday. The road from Dương Đông is about 25 minutes on the bureau account and about 25 km on the 3-day account, along a shore of over 7 km. The sand is cát vàng óng, powder-white, and white, depending on the account. Entrance and parking are free. The sunset beach is Long Beach.
getThere: About 25 minutes by road from Dương Đông
bestMonths: November–April, and lunar month 11 to lunar month 4
heroCaption: Pale sand, shallow water, and the forested hill at Bãi Sao

notice.title: The sunset is on Long Beach
notice.body: Bãi Sao is the southeast swim and the sunrise on the island account. Schedule the Gulf sunset on Bãi Trường.

body: Swim and walk Bãi Sao, and come early on a weekday if you want the shore quiet. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam says the sand is cát vàng óng, fine like a carpet, the sea calm and clear, with green shade trees, Robinson huts, and hammocks. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism calls it powder-white on the island place page and white on the 3-day account, with coconut palms, green hills, and the island’s sunrise. All three colours stay. The 3-day account says the shore runs over 7 km and that entrance and parking are free.

The bureau puts the beach about 25 minutes by road from the centre of Dương Đông. The 3-day account says about 25 km from the centre, near An Thới. Both figures stay. A boat goes 15–30 km offshore for squid, and the bureau names cùi biên mai nướng and rượu sim rừng. Jet skis, a water park, and parasailing are on the island account. Give the beach a half day from the west coast, or the full day if you stay for the swim and the shade.

figures.caption: A fishing boat in the shallows, with the hill behind Bãi Sao
figures.alt: A turquoise fishing boat in clear shallow water at Sao Beach, Phu Quoc

gettingThere: Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam puts Bãi Sao about 25 minutes by road from the centre of Dương Đông. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism’s 3-day account puts it about 25 km from the centre, near An Thới, and says entrance and parking are free. A taxi, a minibus, or a motorbike is the ride the island account names.

legs.heading: From Dương Đông
legs.body: About 25 minutes by road from the centre of town on the bureau account, or about 25 km on the 3-day account. Come early on a weekday.

legs.heading: From Long Beach
legs.body: A half day from the west coast. The sunrise is here. The boat for squid goes 15–30 km offshore.

admissionNote: Vietnam National Authority of Tourism’s 3-day account says entrance and parking are free. Jet skis, a water park, and parasailing are named on the island-hopping account. Those activity prices were left off both pages.
